charges.label: Base freight (per km of booked lane distance, by billed weight band)
charges.quote: up to and including 500 kg: ₹18.00 per km; 501 kg to 2,000 kg: ₹24.00 per km; Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card.

charges.label: Express service premium (15% of base freight)
charges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

charges.label: Fuel surcharge (12% of base freight plus express premium)
charges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

charges.label: Residential delivery (flat per consignment)
charges.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

document_rules.rule: Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; a credit note references the original consignment note number and states the invoice it corrects.
Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date; disputed line items are payable only on resolution, undisputed items remain due.
Carrier invoices fortnightly; payment due 30 days from invoice date.
Services outside the schedule require the Customer's prior written agreement evidenced by a rate confirmation referencing this agreement; otherwise not payable.

ambiguities.description: Band 1 is 'up to and including 500 kg' and band 2 is '501 kg to 2,000 kg'; billed weights strictly between 500 and 501 kg (fractional) fall in neither band, so the per-km rate is undetermined.

The residential charge also applies where the consignee address is a residence even if the booking is not flagged residential; shipment records carry only the residential flag, so an unflagged residence delivery cannot be identified from the data. The spec applies the charge only when special_handling contains 'residential'. Recorded without a shipment condition: the booking flag is the only observable signal and is treated as authoritative for pricing.

notes: Fuel surcharge applies to base freight plus express premium only, not to the residential charge. No weight minimums, no volume discount, no cold_chain/fragile charges (closed list, §5). Weight bands use billed_weight_kg directly.
